query:
SELECT 
  f.id as fuel_id,
  f.total_value as fuel_value,
  f.asaas_charge_id,
  a.id as payment_id,
  a.value as payment_value,
  a.status
FROM fuel_records f
LEFT JOIN asaas_payments a ON f.asaas_charge_id = a.asaas_charge_id
WHERE f.asaas_charge_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.id DESC
LIMIT 10;
